text:
mike_arch: quick idea we should unify pin expiry + rollforward metadata into a compact 'successor hint' surface so clients get a recommended next model and a short advisory window.

sara_arch: sketch the minimal fields? runtime and edge services need deterministic parsing.

mike_arch: proposed string-header set (control plane keeps full proto): successor_hint=v3-compatible; soft_lock_until=2026-04-01T12:00:00Z; deprecation_window_days=7; fallback_chain=v2.9,v2.8; compat_score=85; scope=tenant; scope_id=tenant-42; telemetry_tag=rollhint_v3_42

jordan_runtime: agree on compact headers. enforce label grammar [a-z0-9._-]+ and canonical lowercase tokens to keep serialization deterministic. compat_score helps automated decisions but default should be advisory.

lee_sre: ops needs clarity: explicit deprecation_window and an alert when anchors linger post-window. ops-bot can emit when >5% tenant traffic hits expired anchors.

ops-bot: will add alert rule and channel eng-oncall.

sara_arch: tradeoffs: cheap wire format vs expressivity. plan: pilot as advisory hints, clients can opt-in via honor_rollforward=true to auto-route. i'll write a short RFC addendum and migration plan (2-week opt-in pilot).

mike_arch: +1. i'll draft the ops appendix for forced-evict heuristics and telemetry queries. thanks all :thumbsup:
